title: 微软如何判断用户故事是否适合进入冲刺规划
topic: 微软如何判断用户故事是否适合进入冲刺规划

source.title: Definition of Ready - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: When the development team picks a user story from the top of the backlog, the user story needs to have enough detail to estimate the work needed to complete the story within the sprint. If it has enough detail to estimate, it is Ready to be developed.
If a user story is not Ready in the beginning of the Sprint it increases the chance that the story will not be done at the end of this sprint.

Definition of Ready is the agreement made by the scrum team around how complete a user story should be in order to be selected as candidate for estimation in the sprint planning. These can be codified as a checklist in user stories using GitHub Issue Templates or Azure DevOps Work Item Templates.
It can be understood as a checklist that helps the Product Owner to ensure that the user story they wrote contains all the necessary details for the scrum team to understand the work to be done.
Does the description have the details including any input values required to implement the user story?
Does the user story have clear and complete acceptance criteria?
translations: 开发团队从待办列表顶部选择用户故事时，故事需要包含足够的信息，以便估算在本次冲刺中完成它所需的工作。如果细节足以进行估算，就可以认为该故事已满足“就绪”条件。
如果用户故事在冲刺开始时尚未准备就绪，那么它到冲刺结束时仍无法完成的可能性就会增加。
“就绪定义”是敏捷团队共同约定的标准，用来判断用户故事是否足够完整，可以作为估算候选项进入冲刺规划。团队可以把标准整理为检查清单，例如放进 GitHub Issue 模板或 Azure DevOps 工作项模板。
它可以作为一份检查清单，帮助产品负责人确认：自己编写的用户故事是否包含敏捷团队理解待办工作的必要信息。
描述是否包含实施用户故事所需的任何输入值的细节？
用户故事是否有清晰且完整的验收标准？
fullTextParagraphs: When the development team picks a user story from the top of the backlog, the user story needs to have enough detail to estimate the work needed to complete the story within the sprint. If it has enough detail to estimate, it is Ready to be developed.
If a user story is not Ready in the beginning of the Sprint it increases the chance that the story will not be done at the end of this sprint.

Definition of Ready is the agreement made by the scrum team around how complete a user story should be in order to be selected as candidate for estimation in the sprint planning. These can be codified as a checklist in user stories using GitHub Issue Templates or Azure DevOps Work Item Templates.
It can be understood as a checklist that helps the Product Owner to ensure that the user story they wrote contains all the necessary details for the scrum team to understand the work to be done.
Does the description have the details including any input values required to implement the user story?
Does the user story have clear and complete acceptance criteria?
Does the user story address the business need?
Can we measure the acceptance criteria?
Is the user story small enough to be implemented in a short amount of time, but large enough to provide value to the customer?
Is the user story blocked? For example, does it depend on any of the following:
A deliverable provided by another team (code artifact, data, etc...)
The ready checklist can be written by a Product Owner in agreement with the development team and the Process Lead.
Update or change the definition of ready anytime the scrum team observes that there are missing information in the user stories that recurrently impacts the planning.
The ready checklist should contain items that apply broadly. Don't include items or details that only apply to one or two user stories. This may become an overhead when writing the user stories.
In the case that the highest priority work is not yet ready, it still may be possible to make forward progress. Here are some strategies that may help:

Backlog Refinement sessions are a good time to validate that high priority user stories are verified to have a clear description, acceptance criteria and demonstrable business value. It is also a good time to breakdown large stories will likely not be completable in a single sprint.
Prioritization sessions are a good time to prioritize user stories that unblock other blocked high priority work.
Blocked user stories can often be broken down in a way that unblocks a portion of the original stories scope. This is a good way to make forward progress even when some work is blocked.
fullTextHeadings: When Should a Definition of Ready be Updated

notes.explain: 原文用它描述用户故事已有足够细节，可估算在冲刺内完成的工作。它不等于所有设计和实现细节都已确定。
notes.example: The story has enough detail to estimate and is ready to be developed.

notes.phrase: not Ready in the beginning of the Sprint
notes.meaning: 在冲刺开始时尚未就绪
notes.explain: 这里说的是未就绪故事在冲刺结束时不能完成的风险会上升；原文表达略不自然，常说 at the beginning of the sprint。
notes.example: We found the missing details at the beginning of the sprint.

notes.explain: 这是团队共同约定的门槛，用来判断故事是否足以成为冲刺规划中的估算候选项；不是一份对所有团队都相同的固定清单。
notes.example: Our team recorded its Definition of Ready in the project.

notes.meaning: 理解工作所需的必要信息
notes.explain: 清单帮助产品负责人补足团队理解工作的关键信息，不代表每个故事都要写入只适用于个别情境的细节。
notes.example: The description includes the input values the team needs.

notes.explain: 先确认会影响实施的输入值；这项检查帮助估算和理解范围。
notes.example: Could we list the input values needed for the form?

notes.meaning: 清晰且完整的验收标准
notes.explain: 标准应让团队知道如何判断结果是否符合预期。来源另举可衡量性作为检查项；不要把它扩展成所有依赖都必须先解决。
notes.example: Could we agree on measurable acceptance criteria before estimating?

scenario.title: Check whether a story has enough detail to estimate
english: A high-priority user story is being discussed for the next sprint, but the team cannot estimate it confidently.
The acceptance criteria do not explain how the result will be checked, and a design deliverable from another team is still pending.

Ask the product owner and development team to clarify the measurable outcome and confirm the design timing. Then decide whether the story is detailed enough to estimate; if it is blocked, consider splitting out a part the team can move forward on.
chinese: 团队正在讨论把一项高优先级用户故事放进下个冲刺，但目前无法有把握地估算工作量。
验收标准没有说明如何核对结果，另一团队的设计交付也还未完成。
请产品负责人和开发团队澄清可衡量的结果并确认设计时间，再判断故事是否具体到足以估算；如果有阻塞，可考虑拆出能先推进的部分。

firstAttempt.prompt: 高优先级用户故事准备进入下次冲刺规划，但验收结果不够明确，设计团队的交付时间也未确认。请用英语建议团队补充可核对的验收标准、确认设计时间，并判断是否已有足够信息进行估算。若整项工作受阻，也可提议拆出能先推进的部分。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we define testable acceptance criteria and confirm when the design will be ready? Then we can check whether the story is detailed enough to estimate. If it is blocked, could we split out a part we can move forward on?
firstAttempt.rationale: 答案先把验收结果变得可核对，再确认设计依赖的时间，最后判断信息是否足以估算。拆分只是来源给出的推进策略之一，并非每个团队都必须拆分。

words.example: The team refined the user story before sprint planning.
words.translation: 团队在冲刺规划前完善了用户故事。
words.note: 以用户需求描述待办工作的常见形式。

words.example: We need clear acceptance criteria to estimate the work.
words.translation: 我们需要清晰的验收标准来估算工作量。
words.note: criteria 是复数名词，指判断结果是否符合约定的条件。

words.example: Could we agree on a measurable outcome for this story?
words.translation: 我们能否为这个用户故事约定一个可衡量的结果？
words.note: 让团队能够观察或核验结果，而不只用模糊描述。

words.example: The design is a dependency from another team.
words.translation: 设计是来自另一团队的依赖项。
words.note: 指当前工作需要的其他工作或交付物；需确认状态，不代表它必须全部完成后才能推进任何工作。

words.example: The story has enough detail for the team to estimate the work.
words.translation: 这个用户故事的信息足以让团队估算工作量。
words.note: 此处指评估完成工作所需的工作量。

words.example: Could we split out the part that is not blocked?
words.translation: 我们能否把没有受阻的部分拆出来？
words.note: 来源将拆出可推进的部分列为受阻时的一种策略。

structure.original: When the development team picks a user story from the top of the backlog, the user story needs to have enough detail to estimate the work needed to complete the story within the sprint.
analysis: When 引导时间从句，说明团队从待办列表顶部选取 user story 之后，开始评估这项工作。
主句是“the user story needs to have enough detail”；needs to have 表示“需要具备”，enough detail 是 have 的宾语。
“to estimate the work”说明这些细节要足以支持工作量估算；“needed to complete the story within the sprint”修饰 work，说明要估算哪项工作。
structure.transfer: A story is ready to start when the team can estimate the work and knows how it will be accepted.

rewrite.bad: Let us start now and define the acceptance criteria later.
rewrite.good: Could we agree on the acceptance criteria and note the design dependency before estimating? Then we can decide whether the story is ready for sprint planning.
rewrite.translation: 估算前，我们能否约定验收标准并记录设计依赖？然后再判断这个用户故事是否适合进入冲刺规划。
rewrite.pattern: Could we agree on [the acceptance criteria] and note [the dependency] before [estimating]?

cloze.prompt: Could we define the acceptance ___ before estimating?
cloze.why: acceptance criteria 是固定搭配；criteria 是复数名词。

cloze.prompt: Could we confirm when the design will be ___?
cloze.why: be ready 表示准备好、可以交付。

cloze.prompt: The story is detailed enough to ___ the work. (Hint: make an approximate assessment)
cloze.why: estimate the work 表示估算工作量。

dictation.text: Could we define testable acceptance criteria and confirm when the design will be ready?

apply.prompt: 换成你手头一项真实工作中的验收结果和依赖时间。
apply.sample: Could we define how we will verify the export results and confirm when the data feed will be ready?

dictation.text: If the story is blocked, could we split out a part we can move forward on?

apply.prompt: 说出一个目前未受阻、可以先估算或推进的部分。
apply.sample: The policy detail is pending. Could we split out the screen layout we can estimate now?

translationPractice.prompt: 估算这个用户故事前，我们能否明确可检验的验收标准？
translationPractice.answer: Could we define testable acceptance criteria before estimating the story?
translationPractice.why: 用 could we 礼貌提出建议；testable 表示验收方式可以实际核对。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否确认设计何时可以交付？
translationPractice.answer: Could we confirm when the design will be ready?
translationPractice.why: confirm when 后接完整的间接问句语序。

translationPractice.prompt: 然后我们可以判断这个用户故事是否具体到足以估算。
translationPractice.answer: Then we can check whether the story is detailed enough to estimate.
translationPractice.why: whether 引出是否；detailed enough to estimate 表示信息足够支持估算。

choice.prompt: 验收标准只写着“页面显示正确内容”，没有说明如何核对；设计团队预计下周交付。哪句话最适合在估算前提出？
options: The design is not here, so no part of this work can move forward.
Could we agree on a way to verify the result and confirm the design timing before estimating?
The product owner should fill in every possible detail before the team discusses the story.
choice.why: 团队需要足以理解和估算工作的细节，并核对依赖状态。来源也提醒避免加入只适用于少数故事的过细要求；阻塞时可考虑拆出可推进部分。

output.prompt: 迁移情境：团队要估算一个新员工入职表单的用户故事，但尚未确认必填输入项；一项国家政策说明还在等待。请建议确认输入值和可衡量结果，并提出怎样先推进未受阻的部分。
output.sample: Could we confirm the required input fields and agree on a measurable result for the form? The policy detail is still pending. Could we split out the layout we can estimate now and revisit the remaining part when the input is clear?
check: 是否确认实施所需输入值？
是否把结果说成可衡量、可核对的条件？
是否只拆出能推进的部分，而没有声称所有依赖都必须先解决？

credits.audio: 美式英语合成朗读，非公司员工原声。

taskPhrases.translation: 估算这个用户故事前，我们能否明确可检验的验收标准？
